recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. If the work group wants renewed cross-resource guidance now that SupplyRequest is outside the active core build, handle that as a new DeviceRequest/SupplyRequest boundary issue rather than replaying old DSTU1 wording.
issue_request: FHIR-6254 asked whether DeviceUseRequest should be rolled up into the newly created SupplyRequest resource. The Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept DeviceUseRequest separate and directed that boundaries text explain how patient-focused device-use requests differ from supply requests.
initial_application: The issue was applied in SVN 11310, represented in git by d69f02bc8a0dd13372985d7782a9d00309ad526d, which added a DeviceRequest Boundaries paragraph distinguishing patient-focused use or instructions from SupplyRequest inventory management. DeviceUseRequest had already been renamed to DeviceRequest in 7bf0f7e00f13fcfaec67c9e17d8c89e75f3cf08a.
additional_context: DeviceRequest is active in current source/fhir.ini, while DeviceUseRequest is listed only as removed. Later Published issue FHIR-24936 rewrote healthcare-product scope and boundary text; its implementation commit 578361a9000ef12bb67e86de2e5fb27ea52bd79a removed the original FHIR-6254 paragraph from DeviceRequest while retaining the same patient-focus versus inventory-management distinction on SupplyRequest. Later commit 3b38b80cf23f9cbb306fab8fcedb293315478c32 removed SupplyRequest from active core resource listings, leaving its source as inactive evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source edit was made because active DeviceRequest narrative still describes patient-focused device use and external delivery/fulfillment responsibilities, and the absence of the exact 2017 paragraph is explained by later final boundary refactoring rather than a missed application.

related_jiras.note: Broader healthcare-product scope and boundary update moved the explicit DeviceRequest/SupplyRequest distinction out of DeviceRequest and into SupplyRequest.
Later Applied issue added DeviceRequest fulfillment guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
